messages:
maya: FYI — long-context regen workload on rtx-dedicated shows KV cache mem creeping ~+15% over 24h, looks like fragmentation not reclaimed. Uploaded profiles to gs://redwood-perf/kv/4123456789/ 

sam: Any quick repro or is this only visible in soak? seq length distribution?

maya: Seen in soak and in a repro harness. Seq dist heavy tail, lots >2048. Reuse ratio low. pprof top -> allocator churn on small slabs. Snippet:
```text
pprof: alloc_objects
 0.9s 15%  slab_alloc_small
 0.7s 12%  kv_insert
 0.3s  5%  kv_free (many tiny frees)
```

jordan: That smells like small-chunk stickiness. If free holes are scattered we don't coalesce enough. Did scrubber run?

maya: Scrubber didn't kick — threshold gating prevents run because large entries keep free_below_threshold false. Also see a lot of near-boundary allocations (e.g. many 480B requests hitting 512B bin).

leo: If allocations cluster just under bin boundaries we get internal fragmentation + holes that don't merge. Two quick ideas: widen bin ranges (reduce boundary density) and add an opportunistic merge pass that scans neighbour headers during low-load windows.

anika: Compaction/pass is fine but beware latency spikes. Proposal: background compactor that respects CPU budget and latency SLOs: only run when cpu_idle > 60% && p50_latency < 50ms for 10m, and cap compaction CPU to 2% of core.

sam: Also allocator-side: prefer reuse from LRU candidate list for small chunks instead of always allocating new. Track last-used timestamp and bias allocator to reuse older freed slots first. That reduces hole proliferation.

maya: I'll prototype two small diffs: 1) widen bin widths around 256/512/1024 by +/-20%, 2) increase buddy-merge aggressiveness for adjacent free microblocks, and 3) add observability (hole density, compaction cpu secs). Branch: `kv/frag-widen-bins-4123`.

infra-bot: deploy-bot: Canary deploy queued for `kv-runtime/canary` id `can-41234` (targets: one rtx-dedicated node). ETA ~10m.

jordan: Nice. Add histogram for chunk_size vs slab_id and a gauge for hole_density per slab. Also emit event when compactor runs and how many bytes reclaimed.

maya: Added logs and a quick dashboard: https://console.redwood/metrics/d/kv-frag/4123456789 — will post results after canary.

leo: If canary looks good, rollout plan: 0.1% traffic -> 1% -> 10% over 24h with automatic rollback on mem-growth >5% or p95 latency increase >10ms.

anika: Agree. Also add a short test in perf harness that runs with synthetic long tail tokens to validate no regression in tail latency.

maya: Will run harness now. Assigning follow-ups: maya (run canary & harness), sam (allocator reuse patch), jordan (metrics + dashboard), anika (safety throttles), leo (rollout plan).

sam: Quick note — when you change bin widths document the mapping table (old->new) so downstream tooling (quantization heuristics) can interpret chunk sizing.

maya: Good call. Pushed mapping and PR description includes bin table. Thanks all. :thumbsup:
